prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square retail promotion poster for a free combo gift offer. Split the composition with a photorealistic outdoor lifestyle scene on the left and a bright yellow promo background on the right. Show a young Asian male model wearing sunglasses, a cream short-sleeve overshirt over a white tee, matching shorts, and white sandals, holding a dark brown leather tote, standing on beige gravel. On the right, place black BADASS text at the top, a glowing blue rounded rectangle with product packshots of a polo and white T-shirt, and below it another glowing blue rounded rectangle with underwear packshots. At the bottom-right, add large stacked Vietnamese text 'TẶNG COMBO ÁO HOẶC SỊP' with a blue rounded badge reading 'MIỄN PHÍ'. Add small white product code text 'SHNTK711 - QSVTK711' in the lower-left area. Technical style: photorealistic fashion promo poster with ecommerce graphic panels, bright natural daylight with graphic glow accents, energetic sale mood, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
